# Apache Avro 1.12 schema (unofficial)

Apache Avro does not publish an official JSON Schema for schema declarations (`.avsc` files).
`index.json` in this directory was written by the Spectral maintainers based on the
[Avro 1.12.0 specification](https://avro.apache.org/docs/1.12.0/specification/) and is **not** an Apache artifact.

It only validates the _structure_ of a schema declaration: primitive and named type references, unions,
records and fields, enums, arrays, maps and fixed (including a positive `size`).
Avro semantics that JSON Schema cannot express (name grammar, namespace resolution, full name uniqueness,
field defaults, union restrictions, logical types) are implemented as custom functions in `../../../functions`.

The compiled validator lives in `../../validators.ts` and is generated by `packages/rulesets/scripts/compile-schemas.ts`.
